name: qkd_ctrl_kc-ks2-fe58324a6
purpose: Qwen ROM TP8 (track B) HBM controller strip leaf qkd_ctrl_kc: the kc stream-command crossing (core clock -> ot_async_fifo -> hclk, registered onto the tap chain of the 32 qkd_ctrl_pc leaves) and the end of the strip's fault chain (hclk -> core, kf).  One a strip, at its N end.
